name: Henri
source: An angel who took a place of a pretty girl. She's a friend of [url=/c59366]Wim[/url] who she cooperates with to make her being in this world less dangerous. She hates people who died with their hearts filled with negative feelings (those who were turned into "ghosts"). What happened to her in the past? And why does she hates everyone in this world?
